scope: Current capability routes for all 181 historical version numbers, not restoration of 181 historical code snapshots.

disposition_meaning.active: Capability retained in current implementation; current implementation may contain later repairs. No claim that the original snapshot or all conditions passed.
disposition_meaning.reverted: Historical candidate was not adopted; executable routes point to current replacement implementations only.
disposition_meaning.superseded: Historical whole-version policy was replaced or repaired; use current replacement implementations.
disposition_meaning.legacy_protocol: Historical formal verification track, separate from cognition runtime.

operators.scope: DiscoveryWorld public numerical bindings; existing candidate search and probe selection
DiscoveryWorld authored Boolean forecasts for one shared physical outcome; existing choose_probe selects original actions; actual answer returns to parent
Model declares measured variables and basis ASTs; existing fitter/controller/physical answer execute and retain the declaration in the parent source.

Refresh all paid responses and compare target/reference tests using joint family consequences. At stagnation, transfer an actual positive setting to another object with equal declared basis; test the shared premise even when its negation is impossible inside that family. Retain unresolved measured boundaries in the action pool. If all families are refuted, return the actual conflict to the existing inquiry immediately. If exact cross-object transfer is unreachable, select an existing reachable setting between paid positives with equal basis values to test their shared connected-band premise. Optional experiment:{number,setting} sends an authored point through the same feedback controller and returns actual readouts; same-point retry resumes, revised point preserves the interrupted question as inconclusive.

Optional bind returns comparison_action (research_update on paid evidence) and research_action; design/answer retains contrast_action. Parent selects adoption; proposals do not execute or support claims.

requires: 原生unified任务、会话checkpoint与KnowledgeLibrary；LLM时序入口由InquiryResearchLab适配当前实验室、已付观测和剩余预算。
目录中的撤回版本仍执行现行替代实现。导出预测器后，LLM需选择并finish取得该接口的新确认。
DW模型编写bind(spec,observations,memory)，从公开记录提取带实测索引的数值行，并提供可执行probe；沿用synthesize/choose_probe/execute_procedure。先冻结候选区分，再另购独立确认，支持后调用模型父程序；不能把数值函数自行解释为世界变量。

DW操作前提由公开的重复unsupported_action触发，next_prerequisite只定位失败和已有成功交互；DiscoveryWorldAgent._prepare_research_focus将下一付费模型决策转到该课题。模型提出实验与解释，旧query/after_observation/evaluate执行并向父问题回传。origin=host_execution_failure，不计作自主触发；inaccessible与不支持操作分开。capabilities的interaction_targets从公开角色导出、两臂共享。
DW研究入口已连接旧搜索/区分/冻结确认/父程序；实际采用仍要求模型提交bind与分析源码。反应器设定频率不是正确频率标签；应以公开激活/未校准反馈作为干预结果，复用旧0/1关系、布尔候选区分或query/after_observation/evaluate，不能以预测设定值自证。
已声明且有未审阅实测的非数值子问题，由DiscoveryWorldAgent现有research_focus安排模型写answer，再调用旧evaluate；不自动给支持。判定为supported/refuted/inconclusive均结束此次审阅，无新证据不重复分析。数值binding路径仍自行驱动；两臂都有普通分析工具，Hegel的分析时机由主机安排。

DW子答案已实际返回、父问题reopened且无待决依赖/数值binding/既有parent_program_path时，原research_focus安排模型编写父程序，由旧execute_procedure执行；自定义query/evaluate路径保留，程序路径进入method_decision供继续。触发origin=host_parent_research_continuation；模型自行给候选、区分预测与实际结果分析。method_results包含所有程序及继承历史，局部进度须按path读实际反馈。

已有父程序的最新stop/error经原research_focus提供一次实际结果复议，按method_results.step记录reviewed_program_step；请求和解码失败不消费复议，模型的实际动作可选择修改、分析、继续或停研。method_decision保留last_program_result及原执行入口。两臂程序内program_path/program_results提供本路径历史，原method_results不变。没有将stop自动判为科学反驳。
DW定性区分设计由模型给出hypotheses及experiments，每个实验对同一物理结果提供逐假设Boolean预测；select_experiment复用choose_probe，冻结选择后经旧query/after_observation/evaluate实测回传。全同预测不购测，预测不作标签或支持。改变既有假设/选中实验时重开问题并撤回依赖可用性，保留旧答案证据。
parent_id子课题的refuted/inconclusive实测分析也可返回父问题；显式depends_on及method.requires仍需supported。整个procedure达到method_step_limit时，旧事件中的完整steps进入一次父复议；程序最后动作成功不能掩盖循环。父提示先选择研究动作，仅在改稿时要求write/select_actions。

operators.scope: Refresh all paid responses and compare target/reference tests using joint family consequences. EditPracticeMethodLearner在实际源码变化后运行公开反例案例，复用原实践与发布门槛；它提供真实反馈，不代替作者改写或发布程序。
0.77与0.92已实现父方法保留、派生版本独立支持及失败条件限制。Python作者的practice_trials也已保存完整源码和各案例结果，相同源码可恢复已有覆盖；本次接入method_candidates.json与restore_method，补齐候选可见和显式选回，不另建版本存储或研究算法。
方法作者使用run {operator:'restore_method',trial:'trials/trial_NNN'}选回已有实践源码；这不是预测器evaluate或任务执行期算子。恢复读取原实践及覆盖，不自动选择候选或发布。
PythonArchiveMethodLearner.finish在新稿实践或原发布门槛失败后，检验受支持旧稿并补其自身缺失案例；父子共享剩余预算，旧稿原门槛全部通过才替换发布。选择归于主机保留策略，不能归为LLM自主restore。相同源码同case以最新实践更新基础支持，失败会撤销该case支持。
PythonArchiveMethodLearner在每次作者决策前生成method_decision.json，将各候选最新实测支持、失败、未测案例及restore入口直接传给provider；完整源码与轨迹仍可读取，摘要不推荐或自动选择候选。自主取回实验通过既有子类关闭提交时主机回退，选择与提交分别记录。
